up: Find the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5241111' in the docs table. Then identify all distinct molecules that have a compound record in compound_records linked to that document via compound_records.doc_id. For each molecule, retrieve its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). If a molecule has no SMILES entry, return NULL for that column. Return one row per molecule. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5241111';
